title: Disentangling glial diversity in peripheral nerves at single-nuclei resolution

materials_reviewed.notes: Full text parsed from PDF and review_md. Glial and stromal diversity in mouse and human peripheral nerves reviewed.
Single-nucleus isolation protocol from mouse and human sciatic nerve, Chromium 10x, and RNAscope methods reviewed.
Fig. 1 (nerve atlas), Fig. 2 (fibroblasts), Fig. 3 (immune cells), Fig. 4 (Schwann cell subtypes), Fig. 5 (human Schwann diversity), Fig. 6 (motor vs sensory nerve mapping) reviewed.
